description_excerpt: Job Description • Coordinate with the Global Accounting Service (GS) team to cross-check and follow up on payment requisitions for processing • Archive and organize accounting documents, including debit advice, credit advice, bank statements, and withholding tax certificates • Update exchange rates on a daily basis • Coordinate with the internal audit team on accounting matters • Work with the Controlling team to build and prepare debit notes • Assist with accounting system operations and verify documents and invoices against system data for accuracy • Complete additional tasks as assigned…
